The interviewer sat across from me, the silence of the room heavy and suffocating. To him, this was just another Tuesday, a routine check in a long line of candidates. He glanced at his watch, the second hand sweeping past the twelve, marking the passage of time that felt like an eternity to me. For him, this was a job to be filled; for me, it was the only lifeline left. He adjusted his glasses, looking at my resume with detached curiosity, unaware that my entire future hung in the balance of his next question.

As for your priority question: There are 365 days in a typical year.
